title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode21 Vivid BAD SQUAD

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Miku!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh! Toya's here! So you finally made up? That's great!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No problem.
We wanted you four to discover your true feelings after all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I guess that means our true feelings really were that we wanted to put on the best event we can.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right. Those are the true feelings you four share.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Now, it's time for you all to sing with us.
When you do, those feelings will become a song.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everyone? You want us to sing together with BAD DOGS?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What's wrong? You scared of how good we are?
When it comes to singing, we're not about to lose to anyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh? Sounds like a challenge to me. You'd better be careful if you don't want the Vivids to steal all the best shows from you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Hey, come on you two...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...Heh.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-Aoyagi...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was just thinking how refreshing it is to finally have all that pressure be gone.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito. Let's make sure we don't lose to the Vivids.
song00005_off_f

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hah, that's the spirit.
Toya, you better not have gone and gotten rusty on me, you hear?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. Let's sing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...
That...was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! That felt great! Not bad, you two!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(What just happened?
We were on a totally different level singing with the Vivids.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Maybe the way we'll finally surpass RAD WEEKEND is to...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was our first time singing that song, but it feels like we've always been able to sing it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's because it was born from your desire to put on the best event ever. It's been inside of you all along.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: All along?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? It looks like the name of that Untitled track changed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, you're right! Ready Steady?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your feelings have finally turned into a song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is our song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That was so much fun!
Be sure to come visit again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So long as your feelings remain, we'll be right here waiting.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah! You'd better come back!
Next time, I want to sing with you too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll have fresh coffee beans and tea waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's sing together again soon!
The next day
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello! Oh, Aoyagi, Shinonome! Have you all been chatting?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...Yeah. Shiraishi was telling me more about that SEKAI place. It's quite interesting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't get how feelings turn into a whole world, though. Even after seeing it for myself, it's still hard to believe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, you'll just have to. No use arguing with the facts.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, actually I was hoping to run an idea by the three of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you think about the four of us teaming up for the next event?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I hate to admit it, but performing together yesterday was really fun. I feel like we sounded really good, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And it sounds like all four of us share the same dream of putting on an event that'll surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I figure teaming up would get even closer to achieving that goal. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I think that's a great idea!
I'd like to sing with Shinonome and Aoyagi as well!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, what do you think?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I had the same thought.
If we were to team up, we'd be invincible.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So let's start by deciding on a name!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was thinking since we're the Vivids, named after the street, how about we just combine the two together? So we'll be Vivid BAD.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Could you have put any less thought into it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you don't like it, then why don't you come up with something?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm... Since we're all singing together, it might be an idea to use something like crew or team in the name.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I like it! What about quad since there are four of us?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah, that could work. Or maybe...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What about squad?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's another word for a group or a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It can also mean a kind of stylish gang, yeah?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Vivid BAD SQUAD, then? I like it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All right, Kohane! I knew I could count on you♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I don't know about that... I'm the one who's always relying on you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'll keep working hard to make sure one day you all can!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane! Remember, I'm always here for you!
You're the greatest!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! A-An! I can't breathe!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh... Always so carefree, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Being able to express yourself honestly is a good thing, though.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look who's talking.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The lot in this town never change.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: They sing, they fight, and then they go back to singing.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I guess that's just how people like us make relationships.
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey there! How are you two doing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What's gotten into you, Len? Something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let me guess. Did you make up with Rin?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yep! You got it! She's meeting me here today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is that so? That's great to hear.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. We may fight a lot, but it really is fun having someone to spend time with.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder if that's how things will be with those four as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope we'll be able to sing together again soon.
